audition.text: Cheap hosting has a catch. Neighbors. With a VPS, you get your own apartment.

scenes.intent: Show the tension between a low price and competing for shared resources.

beats.text: Cheap hosting has a catch. Neighbors.

scenes.intent: Move inside the building and demonstrate contention around a single kitchen.

beats.text: With shared hosting, every site uses the same kitchen.
One neighbor gets a rush of traffic, and your site might have to wait.

scenes.intent: Reveal separate virtual environments over one underlying host.

beats.text: With a VPS, you get your own apartment.
Same building, but your own operating system and a set share of resources.

scenes.intent: Translate the analogy into practical trade-offs without invented prices.

beats.text: I'd start with shared hosting for a blog or a small site.
I'd pay more for a VPS if I needed to run custom software.
With an unmanaged VPS, I'd handle the upkeep, too.

scenes.intent: Give viewers a concrete choice to answer with their own project in mind.

beats.text: Would you share the kitchen or get your own place?
